extraction.Name: Lizzie Colomb
extraction.Refused/Protested: Yes I cried for two days after it came because I did not want it, and I did not want to lose my home. I seldom go to the agency so I did not see any of them to protest to. I told a number of my friends that I did not want it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I sold it because the taxes were so high that I could not pay them and I intended to purchase a home over at Okreek
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I sold it because the taxes were so high that I could not pay them
extraction.Occupation/Income: My husband is the chief means of support
extraction.NOTES: Document number 22991; received patent by mail during World War; signed a receipt for the patent; got $1600 in Liberty Bonds and $515.00 in cash for the land; four people depend on her; states 'the Government should not have issued the patent as I did not ask for it'; intended to purchase a home at Okreek; in poor health, states 'some days I feel pretty well and some days I am sick because I am old'; notarized May 8, 1929 by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32
